scope: Read-only static review of latest v21 plus previously read normal-run log; no source edits, no remote run or submission. Exact scriptVersionId314617319 source not verified.
verdict: Worth one informative submission after minimal boundedness/output fixes; unchanged v21 is technically a completed submission-producing candidate, but its deadline and rescue semantics do not justify 12h/score guarantees.

findings.topic: Global timeout not enforced across training/scoring/loading
findings.detail: Worker loads model before first deadline check. trainer.train and candidate rescoring have no deadline. Main cell runs both rescue stages unconditionally even when base consumed deadline; each stage reloads model. 600s output reserve can be consumed, no parent process deadline.

findings.topic: Full JSON coverage is not real candidate coverage
findings.detail: Hidden rerun reads all tasks/queries and initializes two attempts per query to [[0]], so builder gives structural coverage if reached. Base fixed1200s per task with240task/fourworkers has20h worst-case arithmetic, greater than11h50 working budget. Fixed lexicographic ordering can leave tail unprocessed. Builder only runs at end and raises before fallback if zero parsed files.

findings.topic: Aggressive rescue scores are not comparable to normal candidates
findings.detail: Aggressive candidates store score_aug=[beam_score] instead of actual augmented cross-view rescoring, then share the same full_probmul ranking as normal candidates. Can displace old attempt2 without calibrated evidence. attempt1 is anchored to base when available, so protection is only of base top1, not pass@2.

findings.topic: Diversity label differs from implemented feature
findings.detail: Bonus counts union of literal operation-name tokens, not independent views. permute/colors descriptors include digits and do not match exact strings. rot90 multiplicity/compositions are collapsed; a single composed-transform candidate may get several operation bonuses. No measured justification for0.5 weight.

findings.topic: Normal run does not demonstrate rescue gain
findings.detail: Only4public evaluation tasks/5query were actually generated. Log benchmark reports identical2.5/4 task-weighted result for all ranking strategies, including diverse_dual. This metric is not official per-output competition score and is not representatively sampled.

minimum_preparation: Freeze chosen version and dependencies; keep old30.14 result as separate historical reference.
Make deadline cover training/scoring/worker startup; skip rescue when insufficient time; preserve a fallback submission before work and rebuild atomically from partial outputs.
Use coherent candidate score semantics; simplest low-risk first candidate excludes aggressive placeholder-score entries from replacing already available base candidates.
Log attempted task/query coverage, blank fallback count, per-stage elapsed and base-vs-rescue candidate/selection changes. Full hidden run outcome remains unknown until submission.
strategy: Do not block all submission activity on reconstructing old exact source. A carefully frozen v21-derived bounded run answers real hidden-runtime/current-score questions; one score cannot identify rescue/diversity causal benefit. Current27B has no complete submission exporter or proven complementarity, so it should not displace4B anchor merely because it is chosen research backbone.
